name: Safaricom M-Pesa (Daraja API)

webhook.algorithm: VERIFIED NEGATIVE — there is none, and this is the single most important fact in the cluster. Daraja POSTs unsigned JSON to the merchant's CallbackURL / ResultURL / ValidationURL / ConfirmationURL. No header, no HMAC, no timestamp. Authenticity must be constructed by the integrator: (a) an unguessable, per-merchant callback path, (b) Safaricom source-IP allowlisting at the edge, and (c) mandatory re-confirmation via the Transaction Status API keyed on CheckoutRequestID/MerchantRequestID before releasing value. Callback must return HTTP 200 within ~30s or Safaricom retries aggressively — acknow

fees.notes: The Daraja API itself is free. Real cost is the Safaricom Paybill/Till tariff, which is merchant-negotiated and tiered by transaction band — not a flat percentage. Store as null with a note rather than inventing 1.5%.

notes: CORRECTION FROM ADVERSARIAL REVIEW: Kenya only. Daraja is Safaricom Kenya; Tanzanian M-Pesa is Vodacom on a separate stack with an RSA session-key auth model, so shipping TZ here would generate a dead integration. There is also no signature and no timestamp: authenticity must be constructed from an unguessable callback path, an IP allowlist and a mandatory Transaction Status re-query.

M-Pesa is not a payment method you add to a card checkout in Kenya — it is the checkout. A generated Kenyan integration without STK Push is non-functional regardless of how good the card path is, and no shipped provider touches it. Direct Daraja also avoids the aggregator markup on the dominant rail.

SDKs: No official server SDKs. Well-maintained community options: `daraja-api`/`mpesa-node-api` (npm), `django-daraja` and `python-daraja` (PyPI), `smodav/mpesa` (Composer). Generator should emit direct REST; the OAuth-token-cache and Password-builder helpers are the real value-add.
Developer-experience scores are unrated placeholders (3/3); they are not used in ranking.

Overlaps: Paystack, Flutterwave, Peach and Kora all resell M-Pesa. Direct Daraja is cheaper and lower-latency but carries the shortcode/go-live bureaucracy; offer both paths and default new merchants to the aggregator.
Onboarding: application_review. Requires a Safaricom paybill or till shortcode, obtained separately from the API credentials.
